metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code: plugins of function hooks that add panes, bands and guards to the terminal and the desktop app.

plugins.name: pin-me
plugins.description: Pin messages of a long session and find them again in one click, and keep notes at hand above the prompt. Nothing it holds is sent to the model.

plugins.name: usage-bars
plugins.description: Shows session (5h) and weekly usage as 0-100% bars, with the time left until each window resets.
